purpose: Resolve an existing wire term using the unchanged actual controller implementation; not source, operation or authority approval
existing_source: controller.candidate: git commit-tree -S <tree> -p task[head] -m Temporary visual candidate
interpretation: production.authorization.candidate_base is the temporary signed candidate sole parent: the current feature/PR head task[head]. It is not the reviewed dev base task[base]. The independent plan/Gate proof retains and checks reviewed dev base separately; no new optional field, source selection, authority, or weakened base check is introduced.
required_remote_guard: Before candidate checkout/execution require actual temporary ref candidate identity and commit sole parent candidate_base, actual PR current head=candidate_base and base.ref=dev. Source/App/nonce/receipt/Gate/current-request bindings remain mandatory; remote parent check cannot establish private reviewed dev-base/Gate authority.

Wrong/extra/no parent, PR head change, wrong dev target or source move rejects before candidate execution; no coercion of devbase into candidate_base.
